skills.description: One-stop skill for everything frp 内网穿透 / NAT 穿透 / reverse-proxy / 反向代理 — covers both first-time setup (install frp-cli from gitee.com/DYXZYT/frp-cli, optionally buy & configure Aliyun lightweight server as frps host with or without a domain, deploy frps, connect client, add first port mapping) AND ongoing operations (add/update/remove tunnels, switch profiles, hot reload, P2P xtcp/stcp visitor, doctor / status / logs, admin API passthrough). Skill is **idempotent** — on every entry it first checks a setup marker; if already initialized, skips installation/Aliyun walkthrough and jumps straight to operations.

frp 内网穿透一站式 skill，覆盖从零到日常运维全流程。首次使用会引导用户：从 gitee.com/DYXZYT/frp-cli 安装 frp-cli

  备案说明）、配置阿里云控制台和系统双层防火墙、在云端部署 frps 服务端、本机连接客户端、按场景（SSH / Web / RDP / MySQL
  / Minecraft / NAS /
  Webhook）添加第一条端口映射；已初始化的用户会自动跳过安装步骤，直接进入运维模式：增删改隧道、热重载、多 profile
  多服务器切换、xtcp/stcp P2P 直连、doctor 体检、admin API 透传。触发场景包括："内网穿透"、"NAT
  穿透"、"暴露本地服务到公网"、"反向代理"、"SSH 跳板"、"公网访问家里 NAS / 路由器 / 摄像头 / 家里电脑"、"webhook
  本地调试"、"我想做内网穿透但还没装 frp"、"帮我搭一个 frps"、"我刚买了阿里云想做穿透"、"教我用 frp 暴露 SSH / Web /
  Minecraft"、"新机器装 frp-cli"、"切换 dev 和 prod 的 frp 服务器"、"expose localhost"、"tunnel
  localhost"，或用户直接提到 frp / frpc / frps / frp-cli。skill 是幂等的——每次进入都会先检查 $FRP_HOME/.setup-done
  标记，已初始化时不重复安装、不重复购买引导，直接跳到操作流程。
skills.name: frp-cli内网穿透
